bramm.name: Bramm Emberhide
bramm.bio: A copper-black beard, a plain iron axe, and affection delivered as another load of timber.

svala.name: Svala Emberhide
svala.role: Your mother · keeper of the hearth
svala.bio: Golden-brown braids, blue wool and a sharp eye. No one in her household eats by accident.

gorund.name: Gorund Emberhide
gorund.bio: Stone-gray, silver-braided and monumental. His centuries have added strength, never stolen it.

dorrik.name: Dorrik Emberhide
dorrik.bio: Sandy hair, a broken nose and a boast for every occasion. Brave enough to discover fear.

astrid.name: Astrid Emberhide
astrid.bio: Chestnut braid, rust-red wool, cream fur, and the bone hearth pendant she refuses to leave behind.

hrothgar.name: Hrothgar Stonebelly
hrothgar.role: Ancient conqueror · lord of the host
hrothgar.bio: An immense red-bearded veteran. His iron maul and his appetites have settled the fate of clans.

thyra.name: Thyra Stonebelly
thyra.role: Elder matriarch · mistress of the host
thyra.bio: Silver-blond crown braids above dark green wool. Formidable in body, more formidable in bargains.

runa.name: Runa Frostmane
runa.bio: Granite skin, hunting braids and a blue-gray cloak. Beasts trust her hands; she trusts deeds.

eydis.name: Eydis Ironbraid
eydis.bio: Black copper-bound braids, burgundy wool and a smithing apron. A reliable bargain is a beautiful thing.
